column1: # Names READ in bootstrap/stage2/compiler.kofun that the file never introduces,
# and why each is tolerated. (#1622, parent #1401)
# `sh tests/pair-coverage/bindings.sh` fails in BOTH directions against this
# an unlisted unresolved read is new drift, and a listed row whose read now
# resolves is a fix nobody recorded.
# THIS FILE IS EMPTY OF ROWS, AND THAT IS THE RESULT, NOT THE STARTING STATE.
# The gate was written because a read of an unbound name had survived in this
# `build_scope_hir_mode`. PR #1621 bound it, and this ledger records that the
# set is now empty rather than that it was always empty. `sh bindings.sh
# --prove` runs its `unbound` case against an injected read so the gate is
# watched failing on a tree without one.
# An empty ledger here and an empty ledger because the scanner reached nothing
# look identical from the outside, which is why the gate refuses rather than
# passes when it reads no introductions, no reads, or no keyword table out of
# the C half, and why its PASS line carries the denominators.
